description: Overrides Adobe Clean fonts across XML layouts, dialogs, and Jetpack Compose screens with the device's system font.
name: Use System Font

description: Offers Stock, Chat Heads and Native Bubbles on verified Messenger routes on Android 11 and newer. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Allow chat bubbles

description: Lets you screenshot protected chat media, including view-once media and Quicksnap, and stops screenshot notices. This doesn't add replay or saving. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Allow screenshots

description: Hides the Generate AI sticker buttons, generated-sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide AI sticker tools

description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide avatar stickers

description: Hides suggested replies in business conversations. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide business reply suggestions

description: Hides business suggestions as you type. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide business typing suggestions

description: Hides the Chat Moments entry in the menu. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide Chat Moments

description: Hides Messenger quick-promotion banners inside conversations. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide chat promotions

description: Hides event quick-promotion prompts inside chats. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide event prompts

description: Hides Facebook toolbar, profile and sharing shortcuts, and Also from Meta in the Menu tab. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide Facebook shortcuts

description: Hides friend request cards inside the inbox. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide friend request cards

description: Hides the inbox's add-more-people promotion unit. Also hides the tip sheets in notes, like Make my notes public, and the Share your own story card after someone else's stories. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide growth prompts

description: Filters typed inbox ad items, in case Meta brings back the inbox ads it stopped selling in November 2025. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide inbox ads

description: Hides Messenger quick-promotion banners in the chat list. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide inbox promotions

description: Hides the Home and Channels subtabs. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide inbox tabs

description: Hides joined community-chat rows from the main inbox on its next render. Keeps Search, community folders, delivery and unread counts unchanged. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide joined community chats

description: Hides the floating button, toolbar button, Meta AI tab, menu entries and search AI. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide Meta AI

description: Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide People You May Know

description: Stops sending read receipts. Opened encrypted chats can stay unread on this phone. Replying or switching this off may notify the sender. Group coverage isn't verified. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide read receipts

description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide Reels badge

description: Hides the horizontal tray above chats. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide stories and notes

description: Suppresses your outgoing active-typing signal, including in end-to-end encrypted chats. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Hide typing indicator

description: Renames two shared permissions so a re-signed Messenger can install beside Meta apps. Checked 580 builds only. Earlier clean installs stopped at a blank first-run screen.
name: Install beside Meta apps

description: Preserves messages on verified legacy unsend routes. End-to-end encrypted chats are unsupported, and group coverage is unverified. Activity records intercepted legacy unsends, not chat support. Your own unsend may be limited. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Keep unsent messages

description: Gives Messenger's dark mode the colors of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue palette on Android 11. Light mode stays as it is. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first.
name: Material You theme

description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to the Menu tab and side menu. Always on.
name: Open settings from menu

description: Uses Messenger's external-browser branch for HTTP and HTTPS links. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Open web links externally

description: Answers Messenger's own signer lookup, and a Facebook signed with your key calling Messenger, with the original Meta certificate. Always on.
name: Restore screens on re-signed builds

description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories. The photo or video goes to your phone the same way Messenger saves your own. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Save any story

description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo's own image data instead of a re-encoded copy, without its metadata except the rotation tag. Videos and photos over 20 MB are still compressed. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Send photos at original quality

description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back, while the screen underneath holds still. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Slide chats in and out

description: Renders emoji with the phone's own font instead of Messenger's. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: Use system emoji

description: Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Stories you open this way are marked as seen on your side. Long-press Messenger's home screen icon > Patch controls. Starts off.
name: View stories anonymously

description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install for ad attribution.
name: [Ad] Block ad telemetry

description: Stops Facebook downloading ads and its ad model in the background, which saves data, battery and storage.
name: [Ad] Block background ad prefetch

description: Stops Facebook serving ads to other apps. Those apps then show their own ads or none, and rewarded ads can fail.
name: [Ad] Disable Audience Network

description: Hides LINE display ads: the LINE Ads banners, the Smart Channel banner in the chat list and Google AdManager ads.
name: [Ad] Hide ad views

description: LINE no longer loads the Smart Channel banner ads. This patch makes the getBanners and getPrefetchableBanners responses null.
name: [Ad] Remove banner ads

description: Removes the AI Friends button from the Chats tab header. The Album button shows in its place.
name: [Chat] Hide AI Friends button

description: Removes the server-provided tools (Poll, Schedule and more) from the + menu in a chat. Built-in tiles stay.
name: [Chat] Hide attach menu extra tools

description: Removes every LINE Calendar button: in the Chats tab, the chat toolbar and menus, and the Home tab.
name: [Chat] Hide calendar buttons

description: Removes the community (OpenChat) button from the top of the Chats tab header.
name: [Chat] Hide community button

description: Removes the "Events" row from the slide-out menu in a chat room. Events is a different feature from LINE Calendar, and it opens a server-hosted page.
name: [Chat] Hide Events button

description: Removes the LINE GIFT tile from the + attach menu in a chat room.
name: [Chat] Hide LINE GIFT button

description: Hides the "CHECK" tips under some messages, such as a received video.
name: [Chat] Hide tips under messages

description: Removes the Transfer (LINE Pay) tile from the + attach menu in a chat room.
name: [Chat] Hide Transfer button

description: When you open a chat, LINE does not mark it read or send a read receipt. "Mark as read" still works.
name: [Chat] Keep chats unread

description: Keeps messages that others unsend in 1:1 and group chats, with a notice below each one. OpenChat is not covered.
name: [Chat] Keep unsent messages

description: Keeps your place in the news feed when you come back to Facebook. Pull down to refresh the feed.
name: [Feed] Block feed auto refresh

description: Removes the items that Facebook adds to the feed, such as "Pages you may like", promo cards and surveys. "Suggested for you" posts stay.
name: [Feed] Hide page suggestions and promo cards

description: Removes the prompts Facebook adds inside a post, such as "Are you interested in this post?".
name: [Feed] Hide post prompts

description: Removes sponsored posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind.
name: [Feed] Hide sponsored posts

description: Makes Google Drive chat backup and restore work on a re-signed build, through MicroG-RE. Root Mount does not need it.
name: [Fix] Restore chat backup sign-in via MicroG-RE

description: Shows maps again on a re-signed build, with OpenFreeMap tiles. It needs MicroG-RE 7.0.0 or later. Root Mount does not need it.
name: [Fix] Restore location maps via MicroG-RE

description: When LINE is fully closed, push notifications work again on a re-signed build. A Root Mount install does not need this patch.
name: [Fix] Restore push notifications

description: Makes profiles and some Settings pages open again on a re-signed build. A Root Mount install does not need this patch.
name: [Fix] Restore screens on re-signed builds

description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black instead of dark grey. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first.
name: [General] AMOLED black theme

description: Adds "Andrew's Patch Setting" to LINE Settings, below "Profile". There you can turn some patches on or off without patching again, and see the credits and licenses.
name: [General] Andrew's Patch Setting

description: VOOM deep links, shares, and notifications do nothing. If you open the standalone VOOM feed, it closes. Messaging and the other tabs do not change.
name: [General] Disable VOOM

description: Removes the product cards of affiliate shop links from Reels, feed posts and comments. The "Commission eligible" label stays.
name: [General] Hide affiliate product links

description: Removes the Agent i button from the Home header and from the search bar.
name: [General] Hide Agent i buttons

description: Hides the green dots and N badges that mark new items, on header buttons, tabs, menus, lists and settings rows. Unread message counts do not change.
name: [General] Hide new item badges

description: Opens web links in your default browser instead of Facebook's in-app browser. Facebook pages still open in the app.
name: [General] Open links in external browser

description: Opens web links in your default browser instead of LINE's in-app browser. LIFF mini-apps and LINE links stay in LINE.
name: [General] Open links in external browser

description: Opens LINE Pay in the standalone LINE Pay app, so the integrity check that fails on a re-signed build never runs.
name: [General] Redirect LINE Pay

description: Removes the content feed below the friends list on the Home tab: LINE NEWS, official account posts and rankings.
name: [Home] Hide Home content feed

description: Hides the recommended content, hot-topics and ad modules on the Home tab.
name: [Home] Hide Home modules

description: Hides all LINE Premium upsells, badges and pages. It unlocks nothing, because the server enforces Premium.
name: [Premium] Disable LINE Premium

description: Removes the Premium unsend upsells that "Disable LINE Premium" leaves. Ordinary unsend still works.
name: [Premium] Hide premium unsend upsells

description: Adds a Download button beside every reel. Videos save at the best quality the player streams.
name: [Reels] Download any reel

options.description: Saves videos as H.264 with AAC sound, so that apps such as WhatsApp can send them. The device converts a video in another format. This makes the save slower and the file larger.
options.title: Save as H.264

description: Removes the "Are you interested in this reel?" prompt from Reels.
name: [Reels] Hide interest prompts

description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over a reel and ads inside a video.
name: [Reels] Hide sponsored reels

description: Keeps each story on the screen until you tap or swipe to the next one.
name: [Stories] Disable auto advance

description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music. Videos save at the best quality the player streams.
name: [Stories] Download any story

options.description: Saves videos as H.264 with AAC sound, so that apps such as WhatsApp can send them. The device converts a video in another format. This makes the save slower and the file larger.
options.title: Save as H.264

description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories only shows stories people posted.
name: [Stories] Hide sponsored stories

description: Stops Facebook telling the server which stories you saw, so you are not in the viewer list. Stories that you saw still show as seen on this device.
name: [Stories] View stories anonymously

description: Removes the LINE TODAY (News) tab from the main bottom navigation, in both the news-tab and news-row layouts.
name: [Tab] Hide LINE TODAY tab

description: Removes the Shopping tab from the main bottom navigation. This includes the Japan variant (Shopping, ショッピング) and the Taiwan variant (Discover, 逛逛).
name: [Tab] Hide Shopping tab

description: Removes the VOOM (formerly Timeline) tab from the main bottom navigation.
name: [Tab] Hide VOOM tab

description: Removes the Wallet (LINE Pay) tab from the main bottom navigation, in both the normal and mini-tab layouts.
name: [Tab] Hide Wallet tab

description: Adds a "Copy direct link" option to the pin menu, copying the direct CDN media link instead of the Pinterest web link.
name: Copy direct link

description: Stops the AppLovin MAX mediation stack — and with it Pangle, Amazon APS, Chartboost, InMobi, Mintegral, Fyber, Bigo and the rest — from ever initialising. The game starts faster and makes no ad-network requests at all. Requires "Remove ads": on its own it would only make the app fail to find ads, not stop asking for them.
name: Disable ad SDK

description: Removes sponsored pins from the home, search, related and board feeds. Also carries the "Hide product pins" and "Hide board modules in search" filters, both switchable from the Morphe settings screen.
name: Disable ads

description: Neutralises the AppsFlyer attribution SDK, so no install, event or uninstall data leaves the device.
name: Disable AppsFlyer tracking

description: Closes the "confirm your email" modal, and similar ones, when enabled in Morphe settings.
name: Disable email confirmation dialog

description: Stops Pinterest publishing your content to Google (Discover, Assistant, Play Store).
name: Disable Google Engage

description: Blocks the periodic Google Engage job, the other way content reaches Google.
name: Disable Google Engage worker

description: Turns off the embedded advertising and telemetry SDKs (AdMob, Bugsnag, Firebase, Privacy Sandbox) and strips the Advertising ID permission. Push notifications keep working.
name: Disable third-party trackers

description: Hands out an empty Google Advertising ID with "limit ad tracking" turned on, and stops AppsFlyer from sending install attribution and events. The game keeps working normally: nothing in it waits for attribution data.
name: Disable tracking

description: Adds an option to the board's "…" menu to bulk download the images and videos of the loaded pins.
name: Download board

description: Adds a download button to the circular menu you get by long-pressing a pin, so the image can be saved without opening it.
name: Download pin from long press

description: Adds a "Download video" option to the pin menu, saving the clip to the Downloads folder.
name: Download video

description: Collapses Pinterest's ad-only views, so no ad chrome is drawn even if the app builds one. Follows the "Disable ads" switch.
name: Hide ad views

description: Hides the pin comments section, the comment preview and the comments button, when the matching Morphe setting is enabled.
name: Hide comments

description: Hides the "+" (create Pin) navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.
name: Hide Create nav button

description: Hides the create and inbox buttons in the home feed header, when the matching Morphe settings are enabled.
name: Hide greeting header buttons

description: Hides the notifications navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.
name: Hide Notifications nav button

description: Removes the panel Pinterest opens after a screenshot, and stops it watching for screenshots where possible.
name: Hide screenshot share menu

description: Hides the "Recent searches" section on the search screen and below the search bar. Pinterest still logs searches server-side.
name: Hide search history
